title: KML Compounds lesson projection
description: The file the website and the films both read for one Compounds lesson. Lesson 42 already follows this shape. Do not add usage arrays, school links, JLPT, or a second sentence for video. The usage index points at compound.id. Ruby segments are the only reliable source for incidental vocabulary.

background.description: One image for the whole lesson. The source file stays native 16:9. The page crops it to a shallow banner. No compound has its own image.

readings.description: Display header copied from the lesson. Character readings live in the Kanji Master.

kind.description: Set when the target is taught as a proper name, not ordinary vocabulary. The learner page may ignore this.

sourceGloss.description: Original page wording, kept until gloss conflicts are resolved in the lexical overlay.

qa.description: Internal QA only. The learner page ignores this object.

grammarException.description: True when the example uses grammar materially beyond the lesson band because the target word requires it.

review.description: Genuine ambiguity left for human attention.

legacySurface.description: Pre-cleanup surface, kept for migration traceability. Not a second taught word.

segments.description: One segment per ruby span or plain run. A segment with a reading that is not the target compound is incidental vocabulary. Generators should mark content words, not only the target.
